title: Qira Launches Wearable: Motorola Releases moto watch ultra - Ask AI with a Wrist Lift
excerpt: During the Lenovo Innovation World event at IFA 2026, Motorola launched several new products, including the first wearable device with built-in Motorola Qira, t
content_html:
During the Lenovo Innovation World event at IFA 2026, Motorola launched several new products, including the first wearable device with built-in Motorola Qira, the moto watch ultra, the motorola edge 70 plus and edge 70 neo focusing on imaging and battery life, the motorola razr Swarovski Crystal Edition, and the moto snap wireless charger.

The First LTE-Enabled Moto Watch, Wake Up Qira by Lifting Your Wrist or Saying "Hey Qira"

The moto watch ultra is Motorola's first wearable device with built-in Motorola Qira. Users can directly ask questions or retrieve information stored in cross-device memory by lifting their wrist or saying "Hey Qira" between supported Motorola and Lenovo devices. The watch buttons support customization and can switch between Google Gemini, Motorola Qira, or other apps.

This watch is also the first LTE-enabled Moto Watch, allowing users to answer calls and send messages without carrying a phone. It can also ask Qira questions and receive answers via LTE connection. Based on Wear OS by Google, it supports Google Play, compatible apps, NFC wrist payment, IP68 and 5ATM protection, and can be worn while swimming, with an added swimming exercise mode. In terms of health and fitness, Motorola has once again partnered with Polar to introduce Serene breathing exercises, Nightly Recharge sleep recovery assessment, Sleep Plus Stages sleep stage tracking, and Running Coach guided training. This watch will receive two system updates.

Qira is a personal AI developed by Lenovo and Motorola. Four extensions have been announced: support for Lenovo PCs with 16GB of memory; gradual coverage on some models of Motorola edge, signature, and razr series with Android 17 upgrades; launching on the moto watch ultra; and connecting email, calendar, and collaboration apps through Workato, allowing the AI to perform tasks like sending emails and scheduling meetings after authorization.

200-Megapixel Edge 70 Plus and Crystal Edition Razr Make a Joint Appearance

The motorola edge 70 plus features the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 mobile platform, up to 8GB LPDDR5X memory (up to 24GB with RAM Boost) and up to 256GB storage. Its main camera has up to 200 megapixels, the highest ever for Motorola's camera system, supporting OIS, Pantone Validated color and skin tone calibration, 10x super zoom, and 4K recording. It comes with a 6500mAh battery, supports 45W TurboPower wired fast charging and bypass charging, and a 6.78-inch Extreme AMOLED curved screen supporting up to 144Hz refresh rate, preloaded with Android 16. The edge 70 neo uses a 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 sensor for its main camera, and the battery is increased to 7000mAh.

The 2026 model of the motorola razr Swarovski Crystal Edition features the PANTONE Meteorite color, with 35 Silver Night Swarovski crystals hand-set on the back panel, and one 32-cut crystal at the hinge that reflects light as the device folds. The 3.6-inch outer screen can run full applications directly, and when opened, it expands into a 6.9-inch inner screen. Both cameras are 50MP, and the battery lasts over 36 hours. The moto snap wireless charger provides up to 25W wireless fast charging for Qi2.2 devices, and up to 30W charging for supported Motorola devices using its proprietary protocol.

In terms of availability, the moto watch ultra will be available in Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, North America, and parts of Asia-Pacific in the coming weeks; the edge 70 plus will be available in selected countries in Europe and the Middle East, and the edge 70 neo will be available in India in the coming months.
